SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id, m.full_name
FROM member m
JOIN trip t ON m.member_id = t.member_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', m.joined_on) = '2024'
AND (julianday(t.started_at) - julianday(m.joined_on)) > 120
AND t.trip_id = (
  SELECT trip_id
  FROM trip
  WHERE member_id = m.member_id
  ORDER BY started_at ASC
  LIMIT 1
);
